This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Solo" /> [[Tordich Envlo]] was a member of this species.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[near-human]] [[species]] was better acclimated to warm climates than cold ones, requiring specialized protective clothing when in low temperatures.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> a member of this species, [[Tordich Envlo]], was a part of an independent [[freighter]] crew who were doing work on the ice-covered [[planet]] [[Vandor]],<ref name="SoloOG" /> present in the [[Cantina|saloon]] known as [[the Lodge]] when the [[human]] outlaws [[Han Solo]] and [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] first met over a [[Gambling|game]] of [[sabacc]].<ref name="Solo" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their onscreen debut in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', directed by [[Ron Howard]].<ref name="Solo" />
